frontier_selector.why: The culture positive for B. melitensis biovar 3 decided it

support_spans: A 34-year-old breastfeeding woman presented with a subacute painful, warm, and nodular skin lesion at the left side of her body localized between the neck and breast, measuring approximately 3 × 4 cm
One year earlier, the patient had visited an East-Turkish region and experienced a similar lesion that disappeared spontaneously after 10 days
Culture: positive for B. melitensis biovar 3
contradict_spans: She did not report consumption of unpasteurized dairy products or contact with livestock

support_spans: Born prematurely at 28 weeks' gestation with intracerebral bleeding and left hemiplegia, resulting in hydrocephaly, for which a VP shunt was placed
The VP shunt was completely revised at age 14 due to disconnection
A second revision was performed due to intracranial blockage, with a novel VP shunt placed at the right side of the thorax
contradict_spans: No systemic or other localized symptoms present
